gpu_tip: ~50GB total at 128K context — the biggest of the Qwen 3.6 27B builds, but still no reason to chase a 64GB+ card. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 3060 Ti) plus ~64GB of everyday DDR5 system RAM covers it via llama.cpp's layer offloading.
mac_tip: Needs ~50GB — a 64GB MacBook Pro (M4 Pro/Max or M5 Pro/Max) is tight; a 128GB M4 Max or M5 Max gives more headroom.
